purpose: Durable research/provenance sidecar for an issued Betting Edge report. The sidecar enriches history without enlarging or mutating the runner payload, records the authoritative production contract used at issuance, and may retain structured personnel-sweep evidence for material decisions.

compatibility.rule: Schema-2 sidecars and previously issued schema-3 sidecars remain valid immutable historical evidence. The personnelEvidence extension and explicit personnelRequired gate are additive for new reports and do not require rewriting historical sidecars.

fields.label: issued report label
fields.reportPath: exact data/history/runs path of the stored issued payload
fields.feedGeneratedAt: exact feedGeneratedAt recorded in the issued payload

reportReference.rule: slot and ts must exactly match the issued payload; the sidecar never replaces the issued payload as authority.

fields.productionContractOperational: boolean; required post-cutover and must be true
fields.productionContractPath: string; required post-cutover and currently BETTING_EDGE_CONTRACT.md
fields.productionContractBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the authoritative production contract read before handicapping
fields.personnelSweepPath: string; required for new reports using the operational personnel process and currently BETTING_EDGE_PERSONNEL_SWEEP.md
fields.personnelSweepBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the operational personnel addendum resolved for the report
fields.runnerBlobSha: git blob SHA or null if unavailable
fields.feedBlobSha: git blob SHA of data/live-odds.json used for issuance or null if unavailable
fields.researchLibraryBlobSha: git blob SHA of canonical research-library.json
fields.r2ValidationBlobSha: git blob SHA of the active R2 manual read test
fields.governanceDraftOperational: optional historical design provenance only; must not imply draft authority after production cutover
fields.governanceDraftBlobSha: optional exact Git blob SHA of historical design draft

provenance.productionRule: New sidecars must record productionContractVersion=1.0, productionContractOperational=true, productionContractPath=BETTING_EDGE_CONTRACT.md, the exact productionContractBlobSha resolved before handicapping, and the operational personnel addendum path/blob SHA when the personnel process is in force. Historical sidecars remain valid and immutable.

recommendations.shape: array aligned to the issued recs by stable title/identity and ordinal

researchFitFields.grade: A|B|C|D|NR with optional +/- only for communication
researchFitFields.limitation: strongest caveat, conflict, era issue or research gap
researchFitFields.displayText: the concise History Fit wording placed in the issued report's existing hist field

stage2GateFields.personnelRequired: boolean required on every new recommendation after the Stage 2 publication-gate cutover; true when Stage 2 personnel work was material to the serious candidate or materially affects the final decision, including a personnel-driven PASS
stage2GateFields.rule: personnelRequired is the primary structured trigger for personnelEvidence. Recommendation wording that signals lineup, batting order, participation, role, minutes, starter, active/inactive or identity-context dependence is a conservative backstop and may not be used to mark personnelRequired=false to evade Stage 2 evidence.

personnelEvidence.requiredWhen: For new reports, include on a recommendation when personnelRequired=true. This includes Stage 2 personnel work material to a serious candidate or an unresolved personnel assumption materially affecting BET/LEAN/WAIT/PASS status, fair value, uncertainty or playTo. Historical sidecars are not backfilled.

fields.stage2CheckedAt: timestamp or lane-local date/time showing when the deep personnel sweep was performed
fields.dependencyTarget: the exact personnel dependency or dependencies verified as causally relevant to the wager, oriented to the correct team/opponent/participant/role
fields.dependencyRationale: concise explanation of why the dependency can materially affect this exact market/selection
fields.officialSources: array of authoritative source records checked for the material personnel facts
fields.fallbackSources: array of distinct credible current fallback source records; every record must carry a non-empty canonical origin; when the official state remains unresolved, target 3 to 5 distinct fallback source origins where available
fields.fallbackSourceCount: integer count of distinct credible fallback source origins actually used/checked; must equal the fallbackSources array length after origin deduplication
fields.sourceShortfall: null or concise explanation when fewer than 3 credible current fallback sources genuinely exist after an event-specific search
fields.facts: array of material personnel facts found, with projected facts clearly distinguished from confirmed facts
fields.conflictSummary: null or concise description of the material disagreement among credible sources
fields.conflictResolution: null or concise rationale explaining why higher-quality, more direct or more current evidence resolves a conflict; required before STRONG PROJECTION when a material conflict had existed
fields.unresolved: array of material personnel questions that remain unresolved
fields.decisionSensitivity: specific plausible personnel outcome(s) that would materially change fair value, uncertainty, playTo or status; use NO MATERIAL PERSONNEL SENSITIVITY when none remains
fields.preStage2Fair: concise pre-sweep fair-value and/or uncertainty state
fields.postStage2Fair: concise post-sweep fair-value and/or uncertainty state
fields.decisionImpact: concise statement of how Stage 2 changed the decision, or NO MATERIAL CHANGE

personnelEvidence.sourceCountRule: The 3-to-5 target counts distinct credible source origins, not URLs, mirrors or duplicated syndication. Each fallback source must carry a canonical origin. Duplicate normalized origins are rejected by the publication gate and do not count toward fallbackSourceCount. Do not add weak/stale sources to meet the count. If fewer than 3 exist, record sourceShortfall and preserve PARTIAL/UNKNOWN when appropriate.
personnelEvidence.dependencyRule: Personnel evidence must be tied to the actual causal dependency of the exact wager before it is used. Wrong-team, wrong-opponent or wrong-role dependencies must be corrected and researched again where necessary before final status.
personnelEvidence.conflictRule: A material unresolved source conflict prevents STRONG PROJECTION. Preserve PARTIAL/UNKNOWN and widen uncertainty unless a clear quality/directness/recency hierarchy resolves the disagreement and the resolution rationale is recorded.

failureBehavior.researchUnavailable: Use HISTORY LIBRARY UNAVAILABLE in the issued hist field as appropriate and do not fabricate prior IDs.
failureBehavior.sidecarSaveFailure: Deliver the already-validated issued report and surface HISTORY SAVE FAILED — REPORT VALID; do not rebuild or mutate the report solely for sidecar storage.
